scripts.script:
--[[

local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.__LEXSPY_CLEANUP then pcall(env.__LEXSPY_CLEANUP) end
env.__LEXSPY_LOADED = true
local t0 = os.clock()

local Players=game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local TS = game:GetService('TweenService')
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer

local TAG = "[Lex Remote Spy] "
local unpack = table.unpack or unpack
local function isfn(f) return type(f) == "function" end

local can={
	hooks = isfn(getrawmetatable) and isfn(getnamecallmethod),
	setnc = isfn(setnamecallmethod),
	readonly=isfn(setreadonly),
	cclosure = isfn(newcclosure),
	cbvalue=isfn(getcallbackvalue),
	writefile=isfn(writefile),
	folders = isfn(isfolder) and isfn(makefolder),
	loadstr = isfn(loadstring),
	fire=isfn(firesignal),
	hui = isfn(gethui),
}
local function weak() return setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) end
local remFolder = RS:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
local isBB = remFolder ~= nil and remFolder:FindFirstChild("ParryButtonPress") ~= nil 
local S={
	on = true,
	paused = false,
	dir = "All",
	query="",
	bbOnly = false,
	autoscroll = true,
	cap=600,
	log = {},
	nextId = 1,
	sel = nil,
	blocked={},
	ignored={},
	dirty=true,
	maxQueue = 5000,
	muted=weak(),
	listeners=weak(),
	nListen = 0,
	wrapped = weak(),
	conns = {},
	hooked=false,
	dead = false,
}

local BB_NAMES = {
	ParryButtonPress = "Parry Request",
	AbilityButtonPress = "Ability Request",
	ParrySuccess = "Parry Success (server → client)",
	ParryFailed = "Parry Failed",
	ActivateSuper="Activate Super",
	DefensiveMove = "Defensive Move",
	TeleportToStandardGame = "Teleport To Standard Game",
	Emotes="Emotes Remote",
}

local function friendly(path)
	if not path then return end
	for key, label in pairs(BB_NAMES) do
		if path:find(key, 1, true) then return label end
	end
end

local function buildPath(inst)
	local chain = {}
	local p = inst
	while p and p ~= game do 
		table.insert(chain, 1, p)
		p = p.Parent
	end

	if p ~= game or #chain == 0 then return nil end

	local out, from
	if chain[2]==plr then
		out='game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer'
		from = 3
	else
		local root=chain[1]
		local svc = false
		pcall(function() svc = game:GetService(root.ClassName) == root end)
		if svc then
			out = ("game:GetService(%q)"):format(root.ClassName)
		else
			out = ("game:WaitForChild(%q)"):format(root.Name)
		end
		from = 2
	end
	for i = from, #chain do
		out = out .. (":WaitForChild(%q)"):format(chain[i].Name)
	end
	return out
end

local function pathExpr(inst)
	local ok, res = pcall(buildPath, inst)
	if ok and res then return res end
	local cls, nm = "Instance", "?"
	pcall(function() cls, nm = inst.ClassName, inst.Name end)
	return "nil --[[" .. tostring(cls) .. " " .. (tostring(nm):gsub("%]%]", "] ]")) .. " (not in game)]]"
end

local OTHER = {
	BrickColor = function(v) return ("BrickColor.new(%q)"):format(v.Name) end, 
	UDim = function(v) return ("UDim.new(%.4f, %d)"):format(v.Scale, v.Offset) end,
	Rect = function(v) return ("Rect.new(%g, %g, %g, %g)"):format(v.Min.X, v.Min.Y, v.Max.X, v.Max.Y) end,
	NumberRange = function(v) return ("NumberRange.new(%s, %s)"):format(tostring(v.Min),tostring(v.Max)) end,
	NumberSequence = function() return "NumberSequence.new(...)" end,
	ColorSequence = function() return "ColorSequence.new(...)" end,
	EnumItem = tostring,
}

local function ser(v, depth, seen, maxd, code)
	depth = depth or 0
	seen = seen or {}
	maxd = maxd or 6
	local t = typeof(v)

	if t == "nil" or t == "boolean" then return tostring(v) end
	if t == "number" then
		if v ~= v then return "0/0" end
		if v == math.huge then return "math.huge" end
		if v == -math.huge then return "-math.huge" end
		if v % 1==0 and math.abs(v) < 1e15 then return tostring(v) end
		return ("%.6f"):format(v)
	end
	if t == "string" then return ("%q"):format(v) end

	if t == "Vector3" then
		return ("Vector3.new(%.4f, %.4f, %.4f)"):format(v.X,v.Y, v.Z)
	elseif t == "Vector2" then
		return ("Vector2.new(%.4f, %.4f)"):format(v.X, v.Y)
	elseif t == "CFrame" then
		local c = {v:GetComponents()}
		for i = 1, #c do c[i] = ("%.5f"):format(c[i]) end
		return "CFrame.new(" .. table.concat(c, ", ") .. ")"
	elseif t == "Color3" then
		return ("Color3.fromRGB(%d, %d, %d)"):format(math.floor(v.R*255+0.5),math.floor(v.G*255+0.5), math.floor(v.B*255+0.5))
	elseif t == "UDim2" then
		return ("UDim2.new(%.4f, %d, %.4f, %d)"):format(v.X.Scale, v.X.Offset, v.Y.Scale, v.Y.Offset)
	elseif OTHER[t] then
		return OTHER[t](v)
	end

	if t=="Instance" then
		if code then return pathExpr(v) end
		local ok, name = pcall(function() return v:GetFullName() end)
		if ok then return name end
		return "[" .. v.ClassName .. "]"
	end
	if t == "RBXScriptSignal" then
		return code and "nil --[[RBXScriptSignal]]" or "RBXScriptSignal"
	end

	if t == "function" then
		if code then return "nil --[[function]]" end
		local ok, src = pcall(debug.info, v, "s")
		return "function" .. (ok and (" --[[" .. tostring(src) .. "]]") or "")
	end
	if t == "thread" then
		return code and "nil --[[thread]]" or "coroutine"
	end
	if t ~= "table" then return tostring(v) end

	if seen[v] then return code and "nil --[[cycle]]" or "--[[cycle]]" end
	if depth >= maxd then return code and "nil --[[max depth]]" or "--[[max depth]]" end
	seen[v]=true

	local parts = {}
	local n = #v
	local shown = math.min(n, 200)
	for i = 1, shown do
		table.insert(parts, ser(v[i], depth + 1,seen, maxd, code))
	end
	if n > shown then
		table.insert(parts, "--[[+" .. (n - shown) .. " more]]")
	end

	local extra = 0
	for k, val in pairs(v) do
		if not (type(k) == "number" and k>=1 and k <= n) then
			extra = extra + 1
			if extra > 60 then
				parts[#parts+1] = "--[[...]]"
				break
			end
			local key
			if type(k) == "string" and k:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then
				key=k
			else
				key = "[" .. ser(k, depth+1, seen, maxd, code) .. "]"
			end
			parts[#parts+1] = key .. " = " .. ser(val, depth + 1, seen, maxd, code)
		end
	end
	seen[v] = nil 
	return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ", ") .. "}"
end

local function fullPath(r)
	local ok,p = pcall(function() return r:GetFullName() end)
	if ok then return p end
	return "[" .. tostring(r) .. "]"
end

local function shortPath(full)
	if not full then return "?" end
	local bits = {}
	for b in full:gmatch("[^%.]+") do bits[#bits+1] = b end
	if #bits <= 2 then return full end
	return bits[#bits-1] .. "." .. bits[#bits]
end

local function preview(args, n)
	if not args then return "()" end
	n=n or args.n or #args
	if n == 0 then return "()" end
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(n, 3) do
		local s = ser(args[i], 0, {}, 2)
		if #s > 42 then s = s:sub(1, 39) .. "..." end
		out[#out+1]=s
	end
	if n > 3 then out[#out+1] = "..." end
	return "(" .. table.concat(out, ", ") .. ")"
end

local queue = {}
local function push(dir, remote, method, args)
	if not S.on or S.paused or S.ignored[remote] then return end
	if #queue >= S.maxQueue then return end
	queue[#queue+1] = {
		dir = dir, remote = remote, method = method, args = args,
		n = args and args.n or 0,
		stamp=os.date("%H:%M:%S"),
		blocked = S.blocked[remote] == true,
	}
end

local function trimLog()
	local extra = #S.log - S.cap
	if extra > 0 then
		S.log = table.move(S.log, extra + 1, #S.log,1,{})
	end
end

local EVENTS = {RemoteEvent = true, UnreliableRemoteEvent = true}
local REMOTES = {RemoteEvent = true, UnreliableRemoteEvent = true, RemoteFunction = true}

local function classOf(r)
	local ok, c = pcall(function() return r.ClassName end)
	if ok then return c end
end
local function isEvent(r) return EVENTS[classOf(r)] == true end
local function isFunc(r) return classOf(r) == "RemoteFunction" end

local old_namecall,old_newindex,hookedMt

local function wrapInvoke(remote, orig)
	local w=function(...)
		local args = table.pack(...)
		pcall(push, "in", remote, "OnClientInvoke",args)
		return orig(unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end
	S.wrapped[w]=true
	return w
end

local function installHooks()
	if not can.hooks then
		return false, "executor is missing getrawmetatable / getnamecallmethod"
	end


	local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
	hookedMt = mt
	old_namecall = mt.__namecall
	old_newindex = mt.__newindex
	if can.readonly then pcall(setreadonly, mt,false) end
	
	local function nc(self, ...)
		local method = getnamecallmethod()
		if (method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer")
			and typeof(self) == "Instance"
			and not S.muted[coroutine.running()]
			and REMOTES[self.ClassName] then
			local blocked=S.blocked[self]
			if blocked or (S.on and not S.paused and not S.ignored[self]) then
				pcall(push, "out",self, method, table.pack(...))
				if can.setnc then setnamecallmethod(method) end
				if blocked then return nil end
			end
		end
		return old_namecall(self, ...)
	end
	local function ni(self, key, value)
		if key == "OnClientInvoke" and type(value) == "function"
			and not S.wrapped[value]
			and typeof(self) == "Instance" and self.ClassName == "RemoteFunction" then
			return old_newindex(self, key,wrapInvoke(self, value))
		end
		return old_newindex(self, key, value)
	end

	local wrap = (can.cclosure and newcclosure) or function(f) return f end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		mt.__namecall = wrap(nc)
		mt.__newindex = wrap(ni)
	end)
	if not ok then
		pcall(function()
			mt.__namecall = old_namecall 
			mt.__newindex = old_newindex
		end)
	end
	if can.readonly then pcall(setreadonly, mt, true) end 

	if not ok then
		hookedMt = nil
		return false, "couldn't write metatable: " .. tostring(err)
	end
	return true
end 

local function removeHooks()
	if not hookedMt then return end
	if can.readonly then pcall(setreadonly, hookedMt, false) end
	if old_namecall then pcall(function() hookedMt.__namecall = old_namecall end) end
	if old_newindex then pcall(function() hookedMt.__newindex=old_newindex end) end
	if can.readonly then pcall(setreadonly, hookedMt, true) end
	hookedMt = nil
end


local function wrapExisting(remote)
	if not (S.hooked and can.cbvalue) then return end
	local ok, cb=pcall(getcallbackvalue, remote, "OnClientInvoke")
	if ok and type(cb) == "function" and not S.wrapped[cb] then
		pcall(function() remote.OnClientInvoke = cb end)
	end
end

local function track(inst)
	if S.dead then return end
	local c=inst.ClassName
	if EVENTS[c] then
		if S.listeners[inst] then return end
		S.listeners[inst]=inst.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(...)
			push("in",inst, "OnClientEvent",table.pack(...))
		end)
		S.nListen += 1
	elseif c == "RemoteFunction" then
		wrapExisting(inst)
	end
end


local function startTracking()
	table.insert(S.conns, game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
		pcall(track, inst)
	end))
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, all = pcall(game.GetDescendants, game)
		if not ok then return end
		for i, inst in ipairs(all) do
			if S.dead then return end
			pcall(track, inst)
			if i%2500 == 0 then task.wait() end
		end
	end)
end

local function disconnectAll()
	for _, c in ipairs(S.conns) do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
	S.conns = {}
	for _,c in pairs(S.listeners) do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
	S.listeners=weak()
	S.nListen = 0
end


local function copy(text)
	text = tostring(text)
	local tries = {setclipboard, toclipboard, writeclipboard, syn and syn.write_clipboard}
	for i = 1, 4 do
		local f = tries[i]
		if isfn(f) and pcall(f, text) then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function saveFile(name, body)
	if not can.writefile then return false, "writefile unavailable" end
	if can.folders then
		pcall(function() if not isfolder("LexSpy") then makefolder("LexSpy") end end)
	end
	local path="LexSpy/" .. name
	local ok = pcall(writefile, path, body)
	if ok then return true, path end
	return false, "writefile failed"
end

local function quiet(fn)
	local co = coroutine.running()
	S.muted[co] = true
	local res = table.pack(pcall(fn))
	S.muted[co] = nil
	return res
end

local function flash(btn,msg, back)
	if not btn then return end
	btn.Text = msg
	task.delay(1.2, function() btn.Text = back end)
end

local function argList(e)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, e.n do out[i] = ser(e.args[i], 0, {}, 10,true) end
	return table.concat(out, ", ")
end

local function callText(e)
	local path, m = pathExpr(e.remote), e.method
	local params = e.n > 0 and "..." or ""
	if m == "OnClientEvent" then
		return ("%s.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(%s)\n    -- captured %s\nend)"):format(path, params, e.stamp)
	end
	if m == "OnClientInvoke" then
		return ("%s.OnClientInvoke = function(%s)\n    -- captured %s\nend"):format(path, params,e.stamp) 
	end
	return ("%s:%s(%s)"):format(path, m, argList(e))
end

local function editText(e)
	if e.dir == "in" and e.method == "OnClientEvent" and can.fire then
		local a = argList(e)

		return ("firesignal(%s.OnClientEvent%s)"):format(pathExpr(e.remote), a ~= "" and (", " .. a) or "")
	end
	return callText(e)
end

local function detailText(e)
	local path = fullPath(e.remote)
	local L = {
		"Remote   : " .. path,
		"Class    : " .. e.remote.ClassName,
		"Method   : " .. e.method,
		"Direction: " .. (e.dir == "in" and "INCOMING (server → client)" or "OUTGOING (client → server)"),
		"Time     : " .. e.stamp,
	}
	local nice = friendly(path)
	if nice then table.insert(L, "Friendly : " .. nice) end
	if e.blocked then table.insert(L,"Status   : BLOCKED") end

	table.insert(L,"")
	table.insert(L, ("Arguments (%d):"):format(e.n))
	if e.n == 0 then
		table.insert(L, "  (none)")
	else
		for i = 1, e.n do
			table.insert(L, ("  [%d] (%s)"):format(i, typeof(e.args[i])))
			table.insert(L, "      " .. ser(e.args[i]))
		end
	end

	table.insert(L, "")
	table.insert(L, "Generated:")
	table.insert(L,callText(e))
	return table.concat(L, "\n")
end

local renderDetail, genScript

local function selected()
	if not S.sel then return end
	for _, e in ipairs(S.log) do
		if e.id == S.sel then return e end
	end 
end

local UI = {}

local C = { 
	bg = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22),
	bgAlt = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 30),
	panel = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 35),
	row = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40),
	rowSel = Color3.fromRGB(48, 70,110),
	accent = Color3.fromRGB(90, 150, 255),
	incoming = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 140),
	outgoing = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170,60),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235),
	dim = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160),
	danger=Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
	gold = Color3.fromRGB(255,200,60),
}

local function new(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)

	for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do o[k] = v end
	if parent then o.Parent = parent end
	return o
end

local function corner(p, r)
	return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or 6)}, p)
end

local function stroke(p, color, thick, trans)
	return new("UIStroke", {
		Color = color or C.accent,
		Thickness = thick or 1,
		Transparency = trans or 0.5,
		ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
	}, p)
end

local function btn(parent, text, color, size, pos)
	local b = new("TextButton", {
		Text = text, Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.text,
		BackgroundColor3 = color or C.panel, BackgroundTransparency=0.15,
		BorderSizePixel = 0, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
		Size=size, Position = pos,
	}, parent)
	corner(b, 5)
	stroke(b, C.accent, 1,0.7)
	return b
end

local W, H = 820, 540
local TB_H = 68
local EDIT_H, GRID_H=62, 86
local function attach(gui, opener)
	local targets={}
	if typeof(CoreGui) == "Instance" then table.insert(targets, CoreGui) end
	if can.hui then
		local ok, h = pcall(gethui)
		if ok and typeof(h) == "Instance" then table.insert(targets, h) end
	end
	local pg = plr and (plr:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui") or plr:WaitForChild("PlayerGui",5))
	if pg then table.insert(targets, pg) end
	for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
		for _, n in ipairs({"LexRemoteSpy", "LexRemoteSpyOpener"}) do
			local old = t:FindFirstChild(n) 
			if old then pcall(old.Destroy, old) end
		end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(targets) do
		pcall(function() gui.Parent = t end)
		if gui.Parent == t then
			pcall(function() opener.Parent = t end)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function refreshStatus()
	if not UI.status then return end
	local txt,col
	if not S.on then
		txt, col = "OFF", C.danger
	elseif S.paused then
		txt,col = "PAUSED", C.outgoing
	else
		txt, col = "ACTIVE", C.incoming
	end
	UI.status.Text = txt
	UI.status.TextColor3 = col
	UI.dot.BackgroundColor3 = col
end

local function resetDetail()
	S.sel=nil
	UI.detailBox.Text = ""
	UI.detailTitle.Text = "Select an entry"
	UI.editBox.Text = ""
	UI.editId = nil
end

local function buildUI()
	local gui = new("ScreenGui", {
		Name = "LexRemoteSpy", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder=999,
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
	})
	local opener = new("ScreenGui",{
		Name = "LexRemoteSpyOpener", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 999, 
		ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Enabled = false,
	})
	UI.gui = gui
	UI.opener=opener

	local tab = new("TextButton", {
		Text = "LEX", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.text,
		BackgroundColor3 = C.bgAlt, BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 28), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -14),
	}, opener)
	corner(tab, 6)
	stroke(tab, C.accent, 1, 0.4)
	UI.setOpen = function(v)
		gui.Enabled = v
		opener.Enabled = not v
	end
	tab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() UI.setOpen(true) end)

	local main = new("Frame", {
		Name="Main", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W,H),
		Position = UDim2.new(0.5,-W/2, 0.5,-H/2),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active=true, Draggable = true,
	}, gui)
	corner(main, 10)
	stroke(main, C.accent, 1, 0.4)


	local hdr = new("Frame",{
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), BackgroundColor3 = C.bgAlt, BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, main)
	corner(hdr, 10)

	new("TextLabel", {
		Text = "  REMOTE SPY", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,TextSize = 16,TextColor3 = C.text,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Size=UDim2.new(0, 160, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8,0, 0),
	}, hdr)

	UI.dot = new("Frame", {
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10),Position = UDim2.new(0, 172, 0.5, -5),
		BackgroundColor3 = C.incoming, BorderSizePixel=0,
	}, hdr)
	corner(UI.dot, 5)

	UI.status = new("TextLabel", {
		Text = "ACTIVE",Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12,TextColor3 = C.incoming,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 188, 0, 0),
	}, hdr)

	local mode = isBB and "BB MODE" or "UNIVERSAL MODE"

	if not S.hooked then mode = mode .. "  (IN ONLY)" end
	new("TextLabel", {
		Text = mode, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,TextSize = 11,
		TextColor3 = isBB and C.gold or C.dim,BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(0, 240, 1, 0), Position=UDim2.new(0.5,-120, 0, 0),
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
	}, hdr)

	local closeBtn = new("TextButton", {
		Text = "✕", Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = C.danger,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40), Position = UDim2.new(1,-40, 0, 0),

local function passes(e)
	if S.dir == "Incoming" and e.dir ~= "in" then return false end
	if S.dir == "Outgoing" and e.dir ~= "out" then return false end
	if S.bbOnly and not fullPath(e.remote):find("ReplicatedStorage.Remotes", 1, true) then
		return false
	end
	if S.query ~= "" then
		local q = S.query:lower()
		if not (fullPath(e.remote):lower():find(q, 1, true) or e.method:lower():find(q, 1, true)) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function rebuildList()
	if not UI.list then return end

	local shown = {}
	for i=#S.log, 1,-1 do
		if passes(S.log[i]) then shown[#shown+1] = S.log[i] end
	end
	local count = math.min(#shown, 250)


	for i = 1, count do
		local e = shown[i]
		local item = getRow(i)
		item.row.Visible = true
		item.row.LayoutOrder = i
		item.row.BackgroundColor3 = e.id == S.sel and C.rowSel or C.row
		item.stripe.BackgroundColor3 = e.dir == "in" and C.incoming or C.outgoing
		item.id = e.id 

		if not e.rowText then
			local path = fullPath(e.remote)
			e.nice = friendly(path) ~= nil
			e.rowText = ("[%s] %s %s  %s  %s"):format(e.dir == "in" and "IN " or "OUT",e.stamp,shortPath(path), e.method, preview(e.args, e.n))
		end
		local text = e.rowText
		if e.nice then text = "★ " .. text end
		if e.blocked then text="[BLOCKED] " .. text end
		item.txt.Text = text
	end
	for i = count + 1, #rows do rows[i].row.Visible = false end

	if S.autoscroll then UI.list.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0) end 

	local nIn,nOut, nBlocked = 0, 0, 0
	for _,e in ipairs(S.log) do
		if e.dir == "in" then nIn += 1 else nOut += 1 end
		if S.blocked[e.remote] then nBlocked += 1 end
	end
	UI.stats.Text=("%d total  |  %d in  |  %d out  |  %d blocked  |  %d shown  |  out-hook: %s  |  listening: %d"):format(
		#S.log, nIn, nOut, nBlocked, count,S.hooked and "on" or "OFF", S.nListen)
end

function renderDetail()
	local e=selected()
	if not e then
		UI.detailTitle.Text = "Select an entry"
		UI.detailBox.Text = ""
		if UI.editBox then
			UI.editBox.Text = ""
			UI.editId = nil
		end
		return
	end
	local path = fullPath(e.remote)
	UI.detailTitle.Text = (friendly(path) or shortPath(path)) .. "  —  " .. e.method
	UI.detailBox.Text = detailText(e)

	UI.blockBtn.Text = S.blocked[e.remote] and "Unblock" or "Block" 
	UI.ignoreBtn.Text = S.ignored[e.remote] and "Unignore" or "Ignore"

	local out = e.dir == "out" 
	UI.fireLabel=out and "Fire Again" or "Fire Client"
	UI.fireBtn.Text = UI.fireLabel
	UI.fireBtn.Visible = isEvent(e.remote) and (out or can.fire)
	UI.invokeBtn.Visible = out and isFunc(e.remote)

	if UI.editId ~= e.id then
		UI.editBox.Text = editText(e)
		UI.editId = e.id
	end
end

function genScript(list)
	local L={"-- Generated by LEX Remote Spy", "-- " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), ""}
	for _, e in ipairs(list) do
		if passes(e) then
			table.insert(L,"-- [" .. e.stamp .. "] " .. e.method)
			table.insert(L, callText(e))
			table.insert(L, "")
		end
	end
	return table.concat(L,"\n")
end

local lastDraw=0

local function drain()
	if #queue == 0 then return end
	local batch = queue
	queue = {}
	for _, raw in ipairs(batch) do
		table.insert(S.log, {
			id=S.nextId, dir = raw.dir, remote = raw.remote, method = raw.method,
			args = raw.args, n = raw.n, stamp=raw.stamp,
			blocked = S.blocked[raw.remote] == true,
		})
		S.nextId += 1
	end
	trimLog()
	S.dirty = true
end

local beat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	drain()
	local now = os.clock()
	if S.dirty and now - lastDraw > 0.12 then
		lastDraw = now
		S.dirty = false
		pcall(rebuildList) 
	end
end)

env.LexSpy = {
	Toggle = function(state)
		S.on = state ~= false
		refreshStatus()
	end,
	Clear = function()
		S.log = {}
		queue = {}
		S.sel = nil
		S.dirty=true
	end,
	GetLog = function()
		local out = {}
		for i, e in ipairs(S.log) do out[i]=e end
		return out
	end,
	Block = function(r) S.blocked[r] = true end,
	Unblock = function(r) S.blocked[r] = nil end,
	Ignore = function(r) S.ignored[r] = true end,
	Unignore = function(r) S.ignored[r]=nil end,
	GenerateScript = function() return genScript(S.log) end,
	SaveLog = function(name) return saveFile(name or "remote_log.lua",genScript(S.log)) end,
	SetFilter = function(f) S.dir = f; S.dirty = true end,
	SetBBOnly = function(v) S.bbOnly = v; S.dirty = true end,
	Show = function(v) if UI.setOpen then UI.setOpen(v ~= false) end end,
	Unload = function() if env.__LEXSPY_CLEANUP then env.__LEXSPY_CLEANUP() end end,
}

env.__LEXSPY_CLEANUP=function()
	env.__LEXSPY_LOADED = false
	S.on = false 
	S.dead=true
	if beat then pcall(beat.Disconnect, beat) end
	disconnectAll()
	removeHooks()
	if UI.gui then pcall(UI.gui.Destroy, UI.gui) end 

	if UI.opener then pcall(UI.opener.Destroy, UI.opener) end
	queue = {}
	rows = {}
	S.log = {}
	env.LexSpy = nil
	print(TAG .. "unloaded")
end

do

	if not called then
		err = ok
		ok = false
	end
	S.hooked = ok == true
	if not S.hooked then
		warn(TAG .. "hook install failed (incoming still works): " .. tostring(err))
	end

	local uiOk, uiErr = pcall(buildUI)
	if not uiOk then warn(TAG .. "UI build failed: " .. tostring(uiErr)) end

	local trOk, trErr = pcall(startTracking)
	if not trOk then warn(TAG .. "remote tracking failed: " .. tostring(trErr)) end

	task.defer(function()
		S.dirty = true
		pcall(rebuildList)
	end)

	print(("%sloaded in %.0fms | bb: %s | out-hook: %s"):format(TAG, (os.clock() - t0)*1000,tostring(isBB), tostring(S.hooked)))
end

scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local running = false
local savedPosition = UDim2.new(0.5, -110, 0.5, -65)

local function resetPlr()
	if player.Character then
		player.Character:BreakJoints()
	end
end

local function createGUI()
	local oldGui = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("ResetLoopGUI")

	-- Save the old GUI position before deleting it
	if oldGui then
		local oldFrame = oldGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
		if oldFrame then
			savedPosition = oldFrame.Position
		end
		oldGui:Destroy()
	end

	local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	screenGui.Name = "ResetLoopGUI"
	screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Name = "Frame"
	frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 130)
	frame.Position = savedPosition
	frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
	frame.Active = true
	frame.Parent = screenGui

	Instance.new("UICorner", frame)

	local startButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	startButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0)
	startButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0)
	startButton.Text = "START"
	startButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 0)
	startButton.Parent = frame

	local stopButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
	stopButton.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0)
	stopButton.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.6, 0)
	stopButton.Text = "STOP"
	stopButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 0, 0)
	stopButton.Parent = frame

	-- Dragging
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPos

	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false

					-- Save position when dragging ends
					savedPosition = frame.Position
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if dragging and (
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
		) then

			local delta = input.Position - dragStart

			frame.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPos.X.Scale,
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPos.Y.Scale,
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)

	-- Start
	startButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		if running then return end

		running = true

		task.spawn(function()
			while running do
				resetPlr()
				task.wait(0.40)
			end
		end)
	end)

	-- Stop
	stopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		running = false
	end)
end

createGUI()

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	task.wait(0.2)
	createGUI()
end)

------------------------------------------------------------

end

------------------------------------------------------------

Panel.Parent = ScreenGui

local PanelScale = Instance.new("UIScale")

local function fitPanel()
    local vp = Camera.ViewportSize
    local s = math.min(vp.X / 1600, vp.Y / 900)
    PanelScale.Scale = math.clamp(s, 0.72, 1.12)

fitPanel()
Camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fitPanel)

-- HEADER (drag handle)
------------------------------------------------------------
local Header = Instance.new("TextButton")
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 34)
Header.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
Header.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 34)
Header.BorderSizePixel = 0
Header.Text = "EZ AIM V2"
Header.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
Header.TextSize = 16
Header.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
Header.AutoButtonColor = false
Header.Parent = Panel
Instance.new("UICorner", Header).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB BAR
------------------------------------------------------------
local TabBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TabBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 28)
TabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 46)
TabBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TabBar.Parent = Panel
local TabLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", TabBar)
TabLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
TabLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)

local function makeTab(text)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -2, 1, 0)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 36)
    b.BorderSizePixel = 0
    b.Text = text
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 13
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)

end
local tabAim    = makeTab("AIM")
local tabVisual = makeTab("VISUAL")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- CONTENT FRAMES
------------------------------------------------------------
local Content = Instance.new("Frame")
Content.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -84)
Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 80)
Content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Content.Parent = Panel

local function makePage()
    local p = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    p.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)

    p.BorderSizePixel = 0
    p.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    p.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y

end
local AimPage    = makePage()
local VisualPage = makePage()

local function setTab(tab)
    AimPage.Visible    = (tab == "aim")
    VisualPage.Visible = (tab == "visual")
    tabAim.BackgroundColor3    = (tab == "aim")    and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 36)
    tabAim.TextColor3          = (tab == "aim")    and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
    tabVisual.BackgroundColor3 = (tab == "visual") and Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 36)
    tabVisual.TextColor3       = (tab == "visual") and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 200)
end
tabAim.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTab("aim") end)
tabVisual.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTab("visual") end)
setTab("aim")

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ROW BUILDERS
------------------------------------------------------------
local function makeToggle(parent, label, key, order)
    local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 36)
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.Text = ""
    row.AutoButtonColor = false
    row.LayoutOrder = order
    row.Parent = parent
    Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = label
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235)
    lbl.Parent = row

    local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
    pill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 18)
    pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0.5, -9)
    pill.BackgroundColor3 = Config[key] and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 30, 40)
    pill.Parent = row
    Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
    knob.Position = Config[key] and UDim2.new(1, -17, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250)
    knob.Parent = pill
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Config[key] = not Config[key]
        pill.BackgroundColor3 = Config[key] and Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 30, 40)
        knob.Position = Config[key] and UDim2.new(1, -17, 0.5, -7) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -7)
        if key == "ShowFOV" and FOVCircle then
            FOVCircle.Visible = Config.ShowFOV
        end
    end)
end

local function makeSlider(parent, label, min, max, key, order, fmt)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 36)
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.LayoutOrder = order
    row.Parent = parent
    Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 4)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = label
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235)
    lbl.Parent = row

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 10)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 30)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 44, 58)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Parent = row
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new((Config[key] - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = bar
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local function refresh()
        lbl.Text = fmt(label, Config[key])
        fill.Size = UDim2.new((Config[key] - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    end
    refresh()

    local dragging = false
    local function updateFromX(x)
        local rel = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        Config[key] = min + rel * (max - min)
        refresh()
    end
    bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            updateFromX(i.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            updateFromX(i.Position.X)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
end

local function makeCycle(parent, label, key, order, getDisplay, onTap)
    local row = Instance.new("TextButton")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
    row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 36)
    row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    row.Text = ""
    row.AutoButtonColor = false
    row.LayoutOrder = order
    row.Parent = parent
    Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = label .. ": " .. getDisplay()
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235)
    lbl.Parent = row

    row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        onTap()
        lbl.Text = label .. ": " .. getDisplay()
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- POPULATE AIM TAB
------------------------------------------------------------
makeToggle(AimPage, "Aimbot",     "Aimbot",    1)
makeToggle(AimPage, "Sticky Aim", "StickyAim", 2)
makeToggle(AimPage, "Team Check", "TeamCheck", 3)
makeToggle(AimPage, "Wall Check", "WallCheck", 4)
makeCycle(AimPage, "Aim Part",    "AimPart",   5,
    function() return Config.AimPart end,
    function()
        AIM_INDEX = (AIM_INDEX % #AIM_PARTS) + 1
        Config.AimPart = AIM_PARTS[AIM_INDEX]
    end)
makeSlider(AimPage, "FOV Radius", 40, 500, "FOV", 6, function(_, v) return "FOV Radius: " .. math.floor(v) end)
makeSlider(AimPage, "Smoothness", 0.01, 1.00, "Smoothness", 7, function(_, v) return string.format("Smoothness: %.2f", v) end)
makeSlider(AimPage, "Prediction", 0, 100, "Prediction", 8, function(_, v) return "Prediction: " .. math.floor(v) end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- POPULATE VISUAL TAB
------------------------------------------------------------
makeToggle(VisualPage, "ESP Highlight", "ESP",      1)
makeToggle(VisualPage, "Tracers",       "Tracers",  2)
makeToggle(VisualPage, "Rainbow Mode",  "Rainbow",  3)
makeToggle(VisualPage, "Show FOV",      "ShowFOV",  4)
makeToggle(VisualPage, "Lock Line",     "LockLine", 5)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- TOGGLE BUTTON (only this opens/closes the panel)
------------------------------------------------------------
do
    local drag, moved, start, origin
    Toggle.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            drag, moved = true, false
            start, origin = i.Position, Toggle.Position
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = i.Position - start
            if d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
            Toggle.Position = UDim2.new(origin.X.Scale, origin.X.Offset + d.X, origin.Y.Scale, origin.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if drag and not moved then
                Panel.Visible = not Panel.Visible
            end
            drag  = false
            moved = false
        end
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PANEL DRAG (via header)
------------------------------------------------------------
do
    local drag, start, origin
    Header.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            drag, start, origin = true, i.Position, Panel.Position
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if drag and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            local d = i.Position - start
            Panel.Position = UDim2.new(origin.X.Scale, origin.X.Offset + d.X, origin.Y.Scale, origin.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            drag = false
        end
    end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- DRAWINGS
------------------------------------------------------------
local FOVCircle, LockLine

if hasDrawing then
    FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
    FOVCircle.Thickness = 1.5
    FOVCircle.NumSides = 72
    FOVCircle.Transparency = 1
    FOVCircle.Filled = false
    FOVCircle.Visible = Config.ShowFOV
    table.insert(Cleanup, function() FOVCircle:Remove() end)

    LockLine = Drawing.new("Line")
    LockLine.Thickness = 2
    LockLine.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
    LockLine.Transparency = 0.6
    LockLine.Visible = false
    table.insert(Cleanup, function() LockLine:Remove() end)
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ESP STORAGE
------------------------------------------------------------
local Highlights, Tracers = {}, {}

local function clearESP(plr)
    if Highlights[plr] then pcall(function() Highlights[plr]:Destroy() end); Highlights[plr] = nil end
    if Tracers[plr] then pcall(function() Tracers[plr]:Remove() end); Tracers[plr] = nil end
end

local function addESP(plr)
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return end
    clearESP(plr)
    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
    hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Adornee = char
    hl.Parent = char
    Highlights[plr] = hl

    if hasDrawing then
        local tr = Drawing.new("Line")
        tr.Thickness = 1.4
        tr.Transparency = 0.85
        tr.Visible = false
        Tracers[plr] = tr
    end
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- HELPERS
------------------------------------------------------------
local function isAlive(plr)
    local c = plr.Character
    local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    return h ~= nil and h.Health > 0
end

local function isTeammate(plr)
    if not Config.TeamCheck then return false end
    if not LP.Team then return false end
    return plr.Team == LP.Team
end

local function isVisible(targetPart)
    if not Config.WallCheck then return true end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
    if direction.Magnitude < 0.1 then return true end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local filter = {}
    if LP.Character then filter[#filter + 1] = LP.Character end
    if targetPart.Parent then filter[#filter + 1] = targetPart.Parent end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params)
    return result == nil
end

local function getAimPos(part)
    local pos = part.Position
    if Config.Prediction > 0 then
        local vel = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
        local lookahead = Config.Prediction * 0.005
        pos = pos + vel * lookahead
    end
    return pos
end

local function findCandidate()
    local center = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    local best, bestDist = nil, Config.FOV
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP and isAlive(plr) and not isTeammate(plr) then
            local char = plr.Character
            local part = char:FindFirstChild(Config.AimPart) or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if part then
                local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist and isVisible(part) then
                        bestDist = d
                        best = { part = part, plr = plr }
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function stickyValid(t)
    if not t or not t.part or not t.part.Parent then return false end
    local char = t.part.Parent
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
    if not plr or plr == LP then return false end
    if isTeammate(plr) then return false end
    if not isVisible(t.part) then return false end
    -- reject if camera is looking > 90° away (target behind)
    local toTarget = (t.part.Position - Camera.CFrame.Position)
    if toTarget.Magnitude > 0.1 and toTarget.Unit:Dot(Camera.CFrame.LookVector) < 0 then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

------------------------------------------------------------
-- ONE RENDER LOOP, CAMERA PRIORITY +1
-- (runs after default camera, so aim camera write wins cleanly)
------------------------------------------------------------
local StickyTarget = nil

local function renderStep(dt)
    RainbowHue = (RainbowHue + dt * 0.4) % 1
    local rainbow = Color3.fromHSV(RainbowHue, 1, 1)
    local accent  = Config.Rainbow and rainbow or Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)

    local vp     = Camera.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y / 2)

    -- FOV circle (locked center)
    if FOVCircle then
        FOVCircle.Position = center
        FOVCircle.Radius   = Config.FOV
        FOVCircle.Visible  = Config.ShowFOV
        FOVCircle.Color    = accent
    end

    -- ESP
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr == LP then continue end
        local alive = isAlive(plr)
        local skip  = isTeammate(plr)

        if Config.ESP and alive and not skip then
            if not Highlights[plr] or Highlights[plr].Adornee ~= plr.Character then
                addESP(plr)
            end
            local hl = Highlights[plr]
            if hl then
                hl.Enabled = true
                hl.FillColor    = Config.Rainbow and rainbow or Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)
                hl.OutlineColor = Config.Rainbow and Color3.fromHSV((RainbowHue + 0.5) % 1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end
        else
            if Highlights[plr] then Highlights[plr].Enabled = false end
        end

        local tr = Tracers[plr]
        if tr then
            local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if Config.Tracers and Config.ESP and alive and not skip and hrp then
                local sp, on = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                if on then
                    tr.From    = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
                    tr.To      = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
                    tr.Color   = accent
                    tr.Visible = true
                else
                    tr.Visible = false
                end
            else
                tr.Visible = false
            end
        end
    end

    -- Aimbot: pick target, then write camera (safe ordering)
    local activeTarget = nil
    if Config.Aimbot then
        if Config.StickyAim and stickyValid(StickyTarget) then
            activeTarget = StickyTarget
        else
            StickyTarget = nil
            local c = findCandidate()
            if c then
                activeTarget = c
                if Config.StickyAim then StickyTarget = c end
            end
        end

        if activeTarget then
            local aimPos = getAimPos(activeTarget.part)
            local desired = CFrame.lookAt(Camera.CFrame.Position, aimPos)
            local alpha = math.clamp(Config.Smoothness * (dt * 60), 0, 1)
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(desired, alpha)
        end
    else
        StickyTarget = nil
    end

    -- Lock line
    if LockLine then
        if activeTarget then
            local sp, on = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(activeTarget.part.Position)
            if on then
                LockLine.From    = center
                LockLine.To      = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
                LockLine.Color   = Config.Rainbow and rainbow or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
                LockLine.Visible = Config.LockLine
            else
                LockLine.Visible = false
            end
        else
            LockLine.Visible = false
        end
    end
end

pcall(function()
    RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("EZ_AIM_V2_Render")
end)
RunService:BindToRenderStep("EZ_AIM_V2_Render", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, renderStep)
table.insert(Cleanup, function() pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("EZ_AIM_V2_Render") end) end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- PLAYER HOOKS
------------------------------------------------------------
local function hookPlr(p)
    if p == LP then return end
    if p.Character then task.wait(0.5); addESP(p) end
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.5)
        addESP(p)
    end)
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hookPlr(p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hookPlr)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(clearESP)
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() StickyTarget = nil end)

            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y

    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

-- Safe service cloning
local function GetService(serviceName)
    local success, service = pcall(function()
        return cloneref(game:GetService(serviceName))
    end)
    return success and service or game:GetService(serviceName)
end

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- Connection tracking for cleanup
local Connections = {}

local function Track(connection)
    table.insert(Connections, connection)
    return connection
end

-- Configuration with default values
local Config = {
    UI = {
        ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.Insert,
        Visible = true
    },
    
    ESP = {
        Enabled = false,
        Box = false,
        Name = false,
        HealthBar = false,
        Distance = false,
        Chams = false,
        Skeleton = false,
        TeamCheck = true,
        MaxDistance = 1000,
        EnemyColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
        AllyColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
        BehindWall = false,
        BehindWallColor = Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128),
        IgnoreList = {}
    }
}

-- Config path
local CONFIG_PATH = "CustomUI_Config.json"

-- Load config if exists
local function LoadConfig()
    if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_PATH) then
        local success, data = pcall(function()
            return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(CONFIG_PATH))
        end)
        
        if success and data then
            for category, values in pairs(data) do
                if Config[category] then
                    for key, value in pairs(values) do
                        if typeof(value) == "string" and string.find(value, "Enum") then
                            local enumType, enumValue = string.match(value, "Enum%.([^.]+)%.(.+)")
                            if enumType and enumValue then
                                local enum = Enum[enumType]
                                if enum then
                                    Config[category][key] = enum[enumValue]
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            Config[category][key] = value
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            print("Config loaded successfully")
        end
    end
end

-- Save config
local function SaveConfig()
    if writefile then
        local configToSave = {}
        for category, values in pairs(Config) do
            configToSave[category] = {}
            for key, value in pairs(values) do
                if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
                    configToSave[category][key] = tostring(value)
                else
                    configToSave[category][key] = value
                end
            end
        end
        
        local success, err = pcall(function()
            writefile(CONFIG_PATH, HttpService:JSONEncode(configToSave))
        end)
        
        if success then
            print("Config saved successfully")
        else
            warn("Failed to save config:", err)
        end
    end
end

-- Ignore list helpers
local function IsIgnored(player)
    for _, name in ipairs(Config.ESP.IgnoreList) do
        if name == player.Name then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function SetIgnored(player, state)
    local found = false
    for i, name in ipairs(Config.ESP.IgnoreList) do
        if name == player.Name then
            found = true
            if not state then
                table.remove(Config.ESP.IgnoreList, i)
            end
            break
        end
    end
    if state and not found then
        table.insert(Config.ESP.IgnoreList, player.Name)
    end
end

-- UI Creation
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "CustomUI_" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.DisplayOrder = 999999

if syn and syn.protect_gui then
    syn.protect_gui(ScreenGui)
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
elseif gethui then
    ScreenGui.Parent = gethui()
elseif get_hidden_gui then
    ScreenGui.Parent = get_hidden_gui()
else
    ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui
end

-- Main Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 600, 0, 400)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -300, 0.5, -200)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Visible = Config.UI.Visible
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Corner.Parent = MainFrame

-- Title Bar
local TitleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TitleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
TitleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
TitleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TitleBar.Parent = MainFrame

local TitleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
TitleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
TitleCorner.Parent = TitleBar

local TitleFix = Instance.new("Frame")
TitleFix.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
TitleFix.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
TitleFix.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
TitleFix.BorderSizePixel = 0
TitleFix.Parent = TitleBar

local TitleText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TitleText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0)
TitleText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
TitleText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TitleText.Text = "Custom ESP UI"
TitleText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TitleText.TextSize = 16
TitleText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
TitleText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
TitleText.Parent = TitleBar

-- Tab Container
local TabContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
TabContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, -35)
TabContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 35)
TabContainer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
TabContainer.BorderSizePixel = 0
TabContainer.Parent = MainFrame

-- Content Container
local ContentContainer = Instance.new("Frame")
ContentContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 1, -35)
ContentContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 35)
ContentContainer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentContainer.Parent = MainFrame

-- Tab System
local Tabs = {}
local CurrentTab = nil

local function CreateTab(name)
    local TabButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
    TabButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
    TabButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, #Tabs * 35 + 10)
    TabButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
    TabButton.Text = name
    TabButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    TabButton.TextSize = 14
    TabButton.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    TabButton.Parent = TabContainer
    
    local TabCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    TabCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    TabCorner.Parent = TabButton
    
    local TabContent = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    TabContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -20)
    TabContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
    TabContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    TabContent.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    TabContent.Visible = false
    TabContent.Parent = ContentContainer
    
    local UIList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    UIList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
    UIList.Parent = TabContent
    
    local tab = {
        Button = TabButton,
        Content = TabContent,
        Name = name
    }
    
    table.insert(Tabs, tab)
    
    Track(TabButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if CurrentTab then
            CurrentTab.Content.Visible = false
            CurrentTab.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        end
        CurrentTab = tab

local function CreateSlider(parent, text, min, max, default, callback)
    local SliderFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    SliderFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
    SliderFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    SliderFrame.Parent = parent
    
    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    Label.TextSize = 14
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.Parent = SliderFrame
    
    local SliderBG = Instance.new("Frame")
    SliderBG.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8)
    SliderBG.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
    SliderBG.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60)
    SliderBG.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SliderBG.Parent = SliderFrame
    
    local SliderCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    SliderCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    SliderCorner.Parent = SliderBG
    
    local SliderFill = Instance.new("Frame")
    SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new((default - min) / (max - min), 0, 1, 0)
    SliderFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 120, 180)
    SliderFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    SliderFill.Parent = SliderBG
    
    local SliderFillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    SliderFillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
    SliderFillCorner.Parent = SliderFill
    
    local dragging = false
    
    local function update(input)
        local pos = math.clamp((input.Position.X - SliderBG.AbsolutePosition.X) / SliderBG.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
        local value = math.floor(min + (max - min) * pos)
        SliderFill.Size = UDim2.new(pos, 0, 1, 0)
        Label.Text = text .. ": " .. value
        callback(value)
    end
    
    Track(SliderBG.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            update(input)
        end
    end))
    
    Track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
            update(input)
        end
    end))
    
    Track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end))
    
    return SliderFrame
end

-- Utility Functions
local function GetCharacter(player)
    return player.Character
end

local function GetHumanoid(character)
    return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

local function IsAlive(character)
    local humanoid = GetHumanoid(character)
    return humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function IsTeammate(player)
    if not LocalPlayer.Team then return false end
    return player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team
end

local function GetDistance(pos1, pos2)
    return (pos1 - pos2).Magnitude
end

local function WorldToScreen(position)
    local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(position)
    return Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y), onScreen, screenPos.Z
end

local function IsPlayerValid(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if IsIgnored(player) then return false end
    local character = GetCharacter(player)
    if not character then return false end
    if not IsAlive(character) then return false end
    return true
end

-- ============================================================
-- VISIBILITY CHECK (behind wall detection)
-- ============================================================
local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
pcall(function() raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude end)
pcall(function() raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist end)
raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function IsVisible(character)
    local targetPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not targetPart then return false end
    
    local filter = {}
    if LocalPlayer.Character then
        filter = {LocalPlayer.Character}
    end
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filter
    
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin
    
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    
    if result then
        if result.Instance and result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(character) then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    
    return true
end

-- ESP System
local ESPObjects = {}

local function GetESPObject(player)
    if not ESPObjects[player] then
        ESPObjects[player] = {
            Box = CreateDrawing("Square", {Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Visible = false}),
            Name = CreateDrawing("Text", {Size = 13, Center = true, Outline = true, Visible = false}),
            HealthBar = CreateDrawing("Square", {Thickness = 1, Filled = true, Visible = false}),
            HealthBarOutline = CreateDrawing("Square", {Thickness = 1, Filled = false, Visible = false}),
            Distance = CreateDrawing("Text", {Size = 12, Center = true, Outline = true, Visible = false}),
            Skeleton = {},
            Cham = nil
        }
    end
    return ESPObjects[player]
end

local function RemoveESPObject(player)
    if ESPObjects[player] then
        local obj = ESPObjects[player]
        pcall(function() obj.Box:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.Name:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.HealthBar:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.HealthBarOutline:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.Distance:Remove() end)
        for _, line in ipairs(obj.Skeleton) do
            pcall(function() line:Remove() end)
        end
        if obj.Cham then
            pcall(function() obj.Cham:Destroy() end)
        end
        ESPObjects[player] = nil
    end
end

local function UpdateChams(player, character, color)
    if not Config.ESP.Chams then
        if ESPObjects[player] and ESPObjects[player].Cham then
            pcall(function() ESPObjects[player].Cham:Destroy() end)
            ESPObjects[player].Cham = nil
        end
        return
    end
    
    local obj = GetESPObject(player)
    if not obj.Cham or obj.Cham.Parent ~= character then
        pcall(function()
            if obj.Cham then obj.Cham:Destroy() end
        end)
        obj.Cham = Instance.new("Highlight")
        obj.Cham.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    end
    
    if obj.Cham and obj.Cham.Parent ~= character then
        obj.Cham.Parent = character
    end
    
    if obj.Cham then
        obj.Cham.FillColor = color
        obj.Cham.OutlineColor = color
        obj.Cham.FillTransparency = 0.5
        obj.Cham.OutlineTransparency = 0
    end
end

local function UpdateSkeleton(player, character, color)
    local obj = GetESPObject(player)
    
    if not Config.ESP.Skeleton then
        for _, line in ipairs(obj.Skeleton) do
            line.Visible = false
        end
        return
    end
    
    local joints = GetJointList(character)
    
    -- Grow the line pool if needed
    while #obj.Skeleton < #joints do
        table.insert(obj.Skeleton, CreateDrawing("Line", {Thickness = 1, Visible = false}))
    end
    
    -- Hide unused lines
    for i = #joints + 1, #obj.Skeleton do
        obj.Skeleton[i].Visible = false
    end
    
    -- Draw each joint connection
    for i, joint in ipairs(joints) do
        local line = obj.Skeleton[i]
        local partA = character:FindFirstChild(joint[1])
        local partB = character:FindFirstChild(joint[2])
        
        if partA and partB then
            local posA, onA = WorldToScreen(partA.Position)
            local posB, onB = WorldToScreen(partB.Position)
            
            if onA and onB then
                line.From = posA
                line.To = posB
                line.Color = color
                line.Thickness = 1
                line.Visible = true
            else
                line.Visible = false
            end
        else
            line.Visible = false
        end
    end
end

local function UpdateESP()
    -- Sweep out ESP objects for players who are no longer in the game
    local stale = {}
    for player in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        if not player.Parent or not Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) or player ~= Players:FindFirstChild(player.Name) then
            table.insert(stale, player)
        end
    end
    for _, player in ipairs(stale) do
        RemoveESPObject(player)
    end
    
    for player, obj in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        if obj.Cham then
            obj.Cham.Enabled = Config.ESP.Chams
        end
    end
    
    if not Config.ESP.Enabled then
        for player, obj in pairs(ESPObjects) do
            obj.Box.Visible = false
            obj.Name.Visible = false
            obj.HealthBar.Visible = false
            obj.HealthBarOutline.Visible = false
            obj.Distance.Visible = false
            for _, line in ipairs(obj.Skeleton) do
                line.Visible = false
            end
        end
        return
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if IsPlayerValid(player) then
            local character = GetCharacter(player)
            local humanoid = GetHumanoid(character)
            local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            
            if not rootPart then
                RemoveESPObject(player)
                continue
            end
            
            local isEnemy = not IsTeammate(player)
            if Config.ESP.TeamCheck and not isEnemy then
                RemoveESPObject(player)
                continue
            end
            
            local pos = rootPart.Position
            local screenPos, onScreen, depth = WorldToScreen(pos)
            local distance = GetDistance(Camera.CFrame.Position, pos)
            
            if distance > Config.ESP.MaxDistance or not onScreen or depth < 0 then
                RemoveESPObject(player)
                continue
            end
            
            local obj = GetESPObject(player)
            
            local color = isEnemy and Config.ESP.EnemyColor or Config.ESP.AllyColor
            
            if Config.ESP.BehindWall then
                if not IsVisible(character) then
                    color = Config.ESP.BehindWallColor
                end
            end
            
            -- Get bounding box
            local minVec, maxVec = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge), Vector3.new(-math.huge, -math.huge, -math.huge)
            for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local min, max = part.Position - part.Size/2, part.Position + part.Size/2
                    minVec = Vector3.new(math.min(minVec.X, min.X), math.min(minVec.Y, min.Y), math.min(minVec.Z, min.Z))
                    maxVec = Vector3.new(math.max(maxVec.X, max.X), math.max(maxVec.Y, max.Y), math.max(maxVec.Z, max.Z))
                end
            end
            
            local corner1 = WorldToScreen(Vector3.new(minVec.X, maxVec.Y, minVec.Z))
            local corner2 = WorldToScreen(Vector3.new(maxVec.X, maxVec.Y, minVec.Z))
            local corner3 = WorldToScreen(Vector3.new(minVec.X, maxVec.Y, maxVec.Z))
            local corner4 = WorldToScreen(Vector3.new(maxVec.X, maxVec.Y, maxVec.Z))
            local corner5 = WorldToScreen(Vector3.new(minVec.X, minVec.Y, minVec.Z))
            local corner8 = WorldToScreen(Vector3.new(maxVec.X, minVec.Y, maxVec.Z))
            
            local width = math.max(math.abs(corner1.X - corner2.X), math.abs(corner3.X - corner4.X), math.abs(corner5.X - corner8.X))
            local height = math.max(math.abs(corner1.Y - corner5.Y), math.abs(corner2.Y - corner8.Y))
            
            local boxX = screenPos.X - width/2
            local boxY = screenPos.Y - height/2
            
            -- Box ESP
            obj.Box.Visible = Config.ESP.Box
            obj.Box.Size = Vector2.new(width, height)
            obj.Box.Position = Vector2.new(boxX, boxY)
            obj.Box.Color = color
            
            -- Name ESP
            obj.Name.Visible = Config.ESP.Name
            obj.Name.Text = player.Name
            obj.Name.Position = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, boxY - 15)
            obj.Name.Color = color
            
            -- Health Bar
            if Config.ESP.HealthBar and humanoid then
                local healthPercent = math.clamp(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                local barHeight = height * healthPercent
                local barX = boxX - 6
                local barY = boxY + height - barHeight
                
                obj.HealthBarOutline.Visible = true
                obj.HealthBarOutline.Size = Vector2.new(4, height)
                obj.HealthBarOutline.Position = Vector2.new(barX - 1, boxY)
                obj.HealthBarOutline.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
                
                obj.HealthBar.Visible = true
                obj.HealthBar.Size = Vector2.new(2, barHeight)
                obj.HealthBar.Position = Vector2.new(barX, barY)
                obj.HealthBar.Color = Color3.new(1 - healthPercent, healthPercent, 0)
            else
                obj.HealthBar.Visible = false
                obj.HealthBarOutline.Visible = false
            end
            
            -- Distance ESP
            obj.Distance.Visible = Config.ESP.Distance
            obj.Distance.Text = math.floor(distance) .. " studs"
            obj.Distance.Position = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, boxY + height + 2)
            obj.Distance.Color = color
            
            -- Skeleton ESP
            UpdateSkeleton(player, character, color)
            
            -- Chams
            UpdateChams(player, character, color)
        else
            RemoveESPObject(player)
        end
    end
end

-- Main Loop
Track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(UpdateESP))

-- Remove ESP immediately when a player leaves
Track(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    RemoveESPObject(player)
end))

-- ============================================================
-- UNLOAD FUNCTION
-- ============================================================
function Unload()
    for _, conn in ipairs(Connections) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    Connections = {}
    
    for player, obj in pairs(ESPObjects) do
        pcall(function() obj.Box:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.Name:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.HealthBar:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.HealthBarOutline:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() obj.Distance:Remove() end)
        for _, line in ipairs(obj.Skeleton) do
            pcall(function() line:Remove() end)
        end
        if obj.Cham then
            pcall(function() obj.Cham:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    ESPObjects = {}
    
    if ScreenGui then
        pcall(function() ScreenGui:Destroy() end)
    end
    
    print("Unloaded successfully!")
end

-- Load config on startup
LoadConfig()

print("ESP Script loaded! Press " .. Config.UI.ToggleKey.Name .. " to toggle UI")

local function JFBIF_fake_script() -- Frame.Drag 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
	local frame = script.Parent
	local dragToggle = nil
	local dragSpeed = 0.25
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil
	
	local function updateInput(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if dragToggle then
				updateInput(input)
			end
		end
	end)
	
end

	local size = Vector3.new(4.5, 4.5, 0.01)

		task.spawn(function()

				endpoint:InvokeServer(unpack(args))
			end)
		end)
	end
	
	local function quickPart(endpoint, cf, size, extra)
		task.spawn(function()
			local p = endpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", cf, workspace)
			if not p then return end
	
			fastInvoke(endpoint, {"SyncResize", {{Part = p, CFrame = cf, Size = size}}})
			if extra then extra(p) end
		end)
	end

		targetPlayer = targetPlayer or player
		local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)

		end

		end

			isAlive = false

					fastInvoke(endpoint, {"Remove", {p}})
				end

			table.clear(activeParts)

			cleanup()
		end)

				if healthConn then healthConn:Disconnect() end
				cleanup()
			end
		end)

						end
						table.insert(activeParts, p)

		remote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

		_(args)
	end
	
	function SetAnchor(boolean,part)
		local args = {[1]="SyncAnchor",[2]={[1]={["Part"]=part,["Anchored"]=boolean}}}
		_(args)
	end
	
	function MovePart(part,cf)
		local args = {[1]="SyncMove",[2]={[1]={["Part"]=part,["CFrame"]=cf}}}
		_(args)
	end
	
	function Resize(part,size,cf)
		local args = {[1]="SyncResize",[2]={[1]={["Part"]=part,["CFrame"]=cf,["Size"]=size}}}
		_(args)
	end
	
	function AddMesh(part)
		local args = {[1]="CreateMeshes",[2]={[1]={["Part"]=part}}}
		_(args)
	end
	
	function SetMesh(part,meshid)
		local args = {[1]="SyncMesh",[2]={[1]={["Part"]=part,["MeshId"]="rbxassetid://"..meshid}}}
		_(args)
	end
	
	function MeshResize(part,size)
		local args = {[1]="SyncMesh",[2]={[1]={["Part"]=part,["Scale"]=size}}}
		_(args)
	end
	
	function SetName(part,stringg)
		local args = {[1]="SetName",[2]={[1]=part},[3]=stringg}
		_(args)
	end
	
	function Color(part,color)
		local args = {[1]="SyncColor",[2]={[1]={["Part"]=part,["Color"]=color,["UnionColoring"]=false}}}
		_(args)
	end

-- Gui to Lua

-- Instances:

-- ==========================================
-- DRAGGABLE GUI LOGIC
-- ==========================================
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local dragging
local dragInput
local dragStart
local startPos

local function update(input)
	local delta = input.Position - dragStart
	Frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = Frame.Position
		
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

Frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragInput = input
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input == dragInput and dragging then
		update(input)
	end
end)

-- ==========================================
-- FLY SCRIPT LOGIC
-- ==========================================
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local isFlying = false
local flySpeed = 50

local function toggleFly()
	isFlying = not isFlying
	TextButton.Text = isFlying and "UNFLY" or "FLY"
	
	local character = player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	
	if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid then return end
	
	if isFlying then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		
		-- Fly Loop
		task.spawn(function()
			-- Create forces to hold character in air smoothly
			local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
			bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
			bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(10000, 10000, 10000)
			bv.Parent = humanoidRootPart
			
			local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
			bg.CFrame = humanoidRootPart.CFrame
			bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(10000, 10000, 10000)
			bg.Parent = humanoidRootPart
			
			local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			
			while isFlying and character.Parent and humanoidRootPart.Parent do
				local moveDirection = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, 0, -1) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0) end
				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then moveDirection += Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) end
				
				-- Align flight directions with where your camera is looking
				local cameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
				local lookVector = cameraCFrame.LookVector
				local rightVector = cameraCFrame.RightVector
				
				local direction = (lookVector * -moveDirection.Z) + (rightVector * moveDirection.X)
				if moveDirection.Y ~= 0 then
					direction = direction + Vector3.new(0, moveDirection.Y, 0)
				end
				
				if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
					bv.Velocity = direction.Unit * flySpeed
				else
					bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
				end
				
				bg.CFrame = cameraCFrame
				task.wait()
			end
			
			-- Clean up objects when flying is turned off
			bv:Destroy()
			bg:Destroy()
		end)
	else
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
end

TextButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

local function findSyncAPI()
    for _, obj in ipairs(LocalPlayer:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "SyncAPI" then return obj end
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "SyncAPI" then return obj end
    end
    return nil
end

SkyboxBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local textureId = SkyboxInput.Text
    local sync = findSyncAPI()
    if not sync then return end
    local endpoint = sync.ServerEndpoint
    if textureId == "" then return end
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local spawnCF = root.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0)
    endpoint:InvokeServer("CreatePart", "Normal", spawnCF, workspace)
    task.wait(0.2)
    for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Position - spawnCF.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SetName", {part}, "Sky")
            endpoint:InvokeServer("CreateMeshes", {{["Part"] = part}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["MeshId"] = "rbxassetid://111891702759441"}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["TextureId"] = "rbxassetid://" .. textureId}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncMesh", {{["Part"] = part, ["Scale"] = Vector3.new(1000, 1000, 1000)}})
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SetLocked", {part}, true)
            endpoint:InvokeServer("SyncAnchor", {{["Part"] = part, ["Anchored"] = true}})
            break
        end
    end
end)
